run_gaia2_submission: run the GAIA2 benchmark submission pipeline with standard, agent2agent, and noise phases
run_gaia2_with_limit: run the GAIA2 submission pipeline with a scenario limit to test a subset
run_gaia2_with_hf_upload: run the GAIA2 submission and upload consolidated results to a HuggingFace dataset
run_gaia2_oracle_mode: run the GAIA2 submission pipeline in oracle mode for baseline evaluation
run_gaia2_custom_judge: run the GAIA2 submission pipeline with a custom judge model for evaluation
